📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This pull request implements end-to-end Karpenter subnet configuration propagation across the hypershift-operator and karpenter-operator. The karpenter-operator reconciles user-defined OpenShift EC2NodeClass subnets into a shared ConfigMap. The hypershift-operator watches this ConfigMap and incorporates discovered subnets into AWS endpoint service reconciliation. Comprehensive unit and e2e tests validate the subnet aggregation, ConfigMap lifecycle, and propagation workflows. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Hypershift AWS Controller - Karpenter Integration**
`hypershift-operator/controllers/platform/aws/controller.go`, `hypershift-operator/controllers/platform/aws/controller_test.go`|Adds ConfigMap watch on Karpenter subnets; filters by managed-by=karpenter label. Extends reconciliation to pass EC2 client and enrich subnet discovery by merging subnets from NodePools and Karpenter ConfigMap. Includes new helper functions listKarpenterSubnetIDs and enqueueOnKarpenterConfigMapChange. Test coverage validates subnet parsing, deduplication, merging, and ConfigMap change enqueue behavior.| |**Karpenter Operator NodeClass Controller**
`karpenter-operator/controllers/nodeclass/ec2_nodeclass_controller.go`, `karpenter-operator/controllers/nodeclass/ec2_nodeclass_controller_test.go`|Introduces reconcileKarpenterSubnetsConfigMap to aggregate user-defined subnets from OpenshiftEC2NodeClass resources, serializing them as JSON in a management cluster ConfigMap. Lifecycle spans reconciliation, status updates, and deletion. Skips managed-default node classes and handles missing ConfigMaps gracefully. New test validates creation, deduplication, and deletion scenarios.| |**Karpenter Support Constants**
`support/karpenter/karpenter.go`|Adds KarpenterSubnetsConfigMapName constant to centralize ConfigMap name definition alongside KarpenterTaintConfigMapName.| |**E2E Karpenter Integration Tests**
`test/e2e/karpenter_test.go`|Restructures Karpenter e2e tests into two subtests: arbitrary subnet propagation (covers AWSEndpointService discovery, OpenshiftEC2NodeClass creation with subnet selection, ConfigMap validation, and subnet ID propagation) and main karpenter cluster (covers NodePool provisioning, metrics validation, and instance profile verification).
